title: NSA personnel attend Ramsay lecture

tellings.quote: We similarly had something like that happen in Baltimore too

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsay, who studies a story about a crashed craft with alien bodies, says that people from the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that handles communications intelligence, came to one of his talks in Baltimore, Maryland. He says something similar had happened at another of his talks too. He tells it as a sign that intelligence people keep an eye on his research.
